sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation

# Build node graph excluding red
graph = {}
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] > 100:
        continue
    if n['color'] != 'R':
        graph[n['id']] = []

for adj in seg['adjacency_list']:
    i, j = adj[0], adj[1]
    if i in graph and j in graph:
        graph[i].append(j)
        graph[j].append(i)

# BFS from player (23) to purple (16)
from collections import deque
player_id = 23
purple_id = 16

queue = deque([(player_id, [player_id])])
visited = {player_id}
path = None

while queue:
    node, p = queue.popleft()
    if node == purple_id:
        path = p
        break
    for neighbor in graph.get(node, []):
        if neighbor not in visited:
            visited.add(neighbor)
            queue.append((neighbor, p + [neighbor]))

if path:
    # Compute centers for each node in path
    centers_map = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        centers_map[n['id']] = (sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols))
    
    # Determine moves
    moves = []
    for i in range(1, len(path)):
        c1 = centers_map[path[i-1]]
        c2 = centers_map[path[i]]
        dr, dc = c2[0]-c1[0], c2[1]-c1[1]
        if abs(dr) > abs(dc):
            moves.append('UP' if dr < 0 else 'DOWN')
        else:
            moves.append('LEFT' if dc < 0 else 'RIGHT')
    
    print(f"Path to purple ({len(moves)} moves): {moves}")
    print(f"Node colors: {[next(x for x in seg['nodes'] if x['id']==nid)['color'] for nid in path]}")
    
    result = action(moves, intent='solve')
    print(f"Result: level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}, done={result.get('done')}, board_changed={result.get('board_changed')}")
    
    # Check if red cell changed
    seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg2['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'R':
            print(f"Red cell still exists: id={n['id']}, pixels={n['pixels']}")
        elif n['color'] == 'p':
            print(f"Purple cell: id={n['id']}, pixels={n['pixels']}")
else:
    print("No path to purple cell")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
